title: Distance to the inner-product flip neighbor
statement: Let $m$ be a positive integer and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $2m$. Split its coordinates into two blocks, interpret the bits as elements of $\\mathbb F_2$, and let $x,y\\in\\mathbb F_2^m$ be those blocks. Form a new string by replacing the coordinate $x_0$ with $x_0y_0+1$ and $y_0$ with $1$, leaving all other coordinates unchanged, and then interpreting the resulting bits as Boolean values. The relative Hamming distance from $w$ to this new string is at most $1/m$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $2m$
